   S = \frac{1 - 7^{2005}}{1 - 7}

   \]

grade.gold_answer: By the geometric series formula, $1 + 7 + 7^2 + \cdots + 7^{2004} = \frac{7^{2005}-1}{7-1} = \frac{7^{2005}-1}{6}$. Since $\varphi(1000) = 400$, by Fermat-Euler's Theorem, this is equivalent to finding $\frac{7^{400 \cdot 5 + 5} - 1}{6} \equiv \frac{7^5 - 1}{6} \equiv \boxed{801} \pmod{1000}$.
